last.speaker: Eve
last.text: There is currently no general way to refill spent Stamina outside combat. Sleeping can lower Fatigue, but it does not refill Stamina. During combat, Physical characters can use Defensive Posture (+12 Stamina); Arousal characters can use Clear Mind (+6 Stamina).

last.recordedRoom: A central starting point for every new player that passes into the overworld. The place where perhaps you fell asleep, or put on a pair of panties that didn't belong to you. Perhaps one of the simplest and most peaceful location in the overworld. It's probably a good thing that there are no secrets or discoveries to be made at this location.
